openContractsAndWitnessNeeds.minimumMissingRecord: A complete Greater-owned question contract and one concrete useful answer: declared existing faith/recipient relationship without hidden genealogy; exact question and qualified subject; actual answerable evidence and its provenance; contacted-source knowledge and disclosure eligibility; precision, reach, uncertainty and protected/missing-record behavior; interruption and repeat/conflict handling. Specify who learns which fields and what is withheld without leaking protected facts. Do not substitute a source-classification or unknown-only result for the useful positive witness.

An explicit Greater-owned useful task with exact permitted state change, real source-qualified targets and site/geometry, body/item/source/resource inputs, permissions and defenses, resolution order and resistance if any; distinguish instantaneous initiation/completed physical aftermath from any authorized continuing magic. Specify limits, repeat/conflict/suppression, interruption and once-only ending/settlement. Bind physical profiles, ownership/custody and any exceptional authority actually used. No unspecified permanent duration, unrestricted reality rewrite or universal success follows from the native promise.

After W01/W02, supply two useful paid encounters covering question and task and both native Cleric/Wizard routes. Bind each complete legal class17+ actor, repertoire/acquisition/preparation and actual faith/recipient facts, current budgets/RP/Dissonance/Refrain and relevant class histories. Show Action, 120-foot admission/line of effect, V/S/F, base26 plus only lawful actual adjustments paid before interruption, legal counter eligibility/declines/results, exact successful outcome and meaningful protected/uncertain/interrupted/repeat/conflict/lifecycle branches. Preserve regular clocks, no refunds/refills, unique source and custody/obligation histories with full before/after and inverse records. Conditional authored review encounters must remain labeled as such, not campaign events; no actor or event is inferred here.

wholeIdentityGate: The missing question/task effects and paid useful operation are the native central promise, not optional external exceptions.
externalEvidenceScope: Only facts, physical profiles, information permissions or rare cosmological exceptions actually used by a chosen outcome require those corresponding records. Universal deity genealogy or a rare resurrection is not a prerequisite for ordinary question/task review.
minimumNextAction: Provide one explicitly authorized finite useful question and one substantive task contract with their actual supporting facts, then two paid route-complete encounters. Do not resubmit unchanged classification records.
